title: Site comparison reflects finite-Tor constructibility of bounded-below inputs
statement:
Fix the finite-field datum $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell
e p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and $n\ge1$. Put $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $T$ be a finite-type $k$-scheme [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Use ordinary constant-$A$ module sheaves on the small etale and pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules] and the exact comparison pullback $
u_T^*$ for $
u_T:T_{\mathrm{proet}}	o T_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. Let $C\in D^+(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ be any bounded-below complex, and let $a\le b$ be integers. Suppose that $
u_T^*C$ is bounded with intrinsically constructible cohomology [def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility] and has Tor amplitude in $[a,b]$: its derived tensor with every degree-zero pro-etale $A$-module sheaf has cohomology only in that interval [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude]. Then $C$ is bounded with constructible etale cohomology [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes], and $C$ has etale Tor amplitude in $[a,b]$, meaning that $C\otimes_A^L N$ has cohomology only in $[a,b]$ for every degree-zero etale $A$-module sheaf $N$ [def-kun-tor-amplitude, def-kun-derived-tensor]. No constructibility hypothesis on $C$ is assumed.
